sampling: Existing verified current-export Landscape-only collision sampler; all other actors ignored.
height_frame: World cm; source_ground_z excludes the same5cm asphalt clearance as actual Landscape Z.

summary.interpretation: For original exported controls, abs(delta)<=20cm is a necessary pointwise condition for satisfying both10cm gates. Dense interpolated source-grade deltas diagnose the current interpolation; they are not a new requirement that every interpolated source height remain authoritative. Feasibility does not prove geometry fit or final acceptance.
